description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rate of Exchange effective from 02.01.2017 to 08.01.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance. It establishes new official rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges, which is a regulatory function. The content involves setting and modifying legal financial parameters for trade and customs operations, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure changes or other specialized categories.
